page.help: Mewvo wishes members a happy birthday in a channel on their birthday, and can give them a special role for that day. Members add their own birthday with /birthday set in Discord.

status.title: Status
status.off: Announcements are {state}. Pick a channel below to turn them on.

settings.title: Settings
settings.channelHelp: Where the birthday message is posted.
settings.timezoneHelp: Birthdays start at midnight in this time zone. Write it as region and city, like Europe/London or America/New_York.
settings.roleHelp: Given on the birthday and taken away the next day.
